name: Suspicious Encoded PowerShell Command Line
description: Detects suspicious powershell process starts with base64 encoded commands (e.g. Emotet)
author: GAI_CTI
query: ((process.executable:(*\\powershell.exe OR *\\pwsh.exe)) OR (process.pe.original_file_name:(PowerShell.EXE OR pwsh.dll))) AND ((process.command_line:*\ \-e* AND (process.command_line:(*\ JAB* OR *\ SUVYI* OR *\ SQBFAFgA* OR *\ aQBlAHgA* OR *\ aWV4I* OR *\ IAA* OR *\ IAB* OR *\ UwB* OR *\ cwB*))) OR (process.command_line:(*.exe\ \-ENCOD\ * OR *\ BA\^J\ e\-*))) AND (NOT process.command_line:*\ \-ExecutionPolicy\ remotesigned\ *)
